compliance: This website aims to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA. We believe it is fully compliant, and we treat any failure you find as a fault to fix, not feedback to file.
features: Every page works with a keyboard alone, with a clear focus indicator
Text and background colours meet AA contrast standards
Content is written in plain English and structured with headings
The site works with screen readers and up to 400% text magnification
Every button and link you tap or click is at least 24 by 24 pixels
Nothing on the site requires dragging, and nothing moves unless you ask it to
Every price and regulatory figure is written out in the page text, not shown only as an image
nonAccessible: The illustrative map on the home and about pages is a static image. It has a full text alternative alongside it, but it cannot be zoomed or explored with a screen reader.
testing: This statement was prepared on 4 August 2026. The site is checked with automated testing (axe-core) on every build, and manually with keyboard-only navigation and screen-reader spot checks. It was last reviewed on 4 August 2026.

reporting.copy: If any part of this website is difficult to use with assistive technology — or you need information in a different format, such as large print or easy read — contact us and we will fix it or provide an alternative within five working days.

enforcement: The Equality and Human Rights Commission (EHRC) enforces the accessibility regulations. If you report a problem and are not happy with how we respond, contact the Equality Advisory and Support Service (EASS) at equalityadvisoryservice.com.
thirdParty: This site links to NHS services such as NHS 111 online, and to the General Dental Council's public register. Those services publish their own accessibility statements, which apply once you leave this site.
noOverlay: We deliberately do not use an accessibility overlay or toolbar widget. Overlays cannot make a website compliant on their own and often make it harder to use with real assistive technology — accessibility is built into every page instead.
